title: Capture the owed Zoning Resolution sections the open readings rest on that are NOT yet in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/: the three Board-of-Standards-and-Appeals community-facility special-permit categories ZR 73-11/73-13/73-18 that ZR 24-111(a) carves out of the residential floor-area cap, and the Article VII Chapter 7 'zoning lots divided by district boundaries' family (77-00/77-01/77-10/77-11/77-12/77-20/77-21/77-211/77-22/77-24/77-25/77-26/77-27/77-28) that option 8's open split-lot question (owner N1) would rest on; plus ZR 76-131 (overlay boundary default depth) and ZR 35-36 (special rules for certain areas); and attempt the documented browser-UA print/PDF-node fallback for ZR 23-154 (Universal Affordability Preference), capturing it only if the official text becomes readable. Documents only: source-text snapshots in the existing zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape with byte-identical bundled copies produced by running sync_zr_snapshots.py; no rule, no reading of the text for any lot, no computed figure, no eligibility determination; then reconcile the law library's capture-state flags for the sections this pass captures.
objective: Capture, from zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov, the sections the OPEN readings rest on that are NOT in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ at the contract base, ordered so the 24-111 carve-out group comes first: (A) the three BSA community-facility special-permit categories ZR 24-111(a) names as carved out of the residential-FAR cap, each a prose parent heading with children (capture the heading as shown; list children as adjacent-not-in-batch): 73-11 (Agriculture and Open Uses; children 73-111/73-112; 6/6/2024), 73-13 (Community Facilities; children 73-131..73-136; 6/6/2024), 73-18 (Recreation, Entertainment and Assembly Spaces; children 73-181..73-185; 6/6/2024). (B) The Article VII Chapter 7 'zoning lots divided by district boundaries' family the option-8 readers named plus its two bulk/use parent headings (chapter Last Amended 3/22/2016, all prose, no tables): 77-00 (General Provisions), 77-01 (Applicability of This Chapter), 77-10 (Use Regulations heading), 77-11 (Conditions for Application of Use Regulations to Entire Zoning Lot), 77-12 (Application of Use Regulations Under All Other Conditions), 77-20 (Bulk Regulations heading), 77-21 (General Provisions), 77-211 (Conditions for application of bulk regulations to entire zoning lot), 77-22 (Floor Area Ratio), 77-24 (Lot Coverage), 77-25 (Density Requirements), 77-26 (Minimum Lot Area and Lot Width Requirements for Residences), 77-27 (Yard Regulations), 77-28 (Height and Setback Regulations). (B2) Two more sections the open readings of 2026-10-15 rest on (session 2026-10-15c research return H13): ZR 76-131 (the default location of an undimensioned commercial-overlay boundary: C2-2 = 150 ft from the street) and ZR 35-36 (special rules for certain areas, the one unread residual of the 35-31 carve-outs); take numbers, titles, nodes and dates from the page read this pass. (C) CONDITIONAL: attempt the documented direct-GET browser-UA print/PDF entityprint node fallback for 23-154 (Universal Affordability Preference); capture zr-23-154 ONLY if the fallback returns HTTP 200 and the official text is readable; if it is still 403 after the fallback, write NO 23-154 file, record a dated access-blocked note in the producer report and leave the library's 23-154 entry NOT CAPTURED. Each capture = one JSON in the zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape (template zr-73-432.snapshot.json): official HTML node request + print/PDF entityprint cross-check, both sha256-pinned (or the disclosed 403/504 fallback), the page's own Last Amended stamp, verbatim_excerpt with #term# markers and list letters from the official PRINT, any table carried cell-by-cell in a `table`/`tables` field with a '[table - see structured table field]' placeholder in the excerpt AND the section's own legend quoted verbatim, content_digest_sha256 = sha256(verbatim_excerpt), and — ONLY IF the page read this pass carries a table payload — table_digest_sha256 = sha256 of the canonical JSON of the parsed payload per app.rules.snapshots._verify_table_digest (M3-T013/DB-276); a section with no table payload MUST NOT carry the key. extraction_status extracted_draft, raw_html_verified per the template, the ADR-007 not-professionally-reviewed label. Each lands in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ AND as a byte-identical copy in services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/ produced by RUNNING services/api/scripts/sync_zr_snapshots.py (never hand-edited). Every number/title/URL/node/date is taken from the page read this pass; a missing/renumbered node (City of Yes 12/5/2024) is reported, never invented. THEN reconcile capture-state flags ONLY, no new reading: in benchmark-r6b-sections.json flip the 77-00 entry to captured (snapshot_id zr-77-00 + content_digest, list the captured family subset in its notes) and flip the 73-11/73-13/73-18 cross_references_out of the 24-111 entry to captured:true with their snapshot ids; flip 23-154 to captured ONLY if (C) succeeded; update counts to reconcile with the final folder listing; keep shared-housing NOT CAPTURED. In coverage.md, cross-reference-closure.md, options-sections.md, options/README.md, option-02-03 and option-08-split-lot/option-11-combinations, flip the matching 'NOT CAPTURED' flags for 77-00 (and 23-154 only if captured); leave option 8's split-lot meaning (owner N1) OPEN and 24-111's R6B CF-FAR effect an OPEN reading question. Documents only: no rule, reading for a lot, computed number, eligibility determination, or label-vocabulary change.
business_reason: 24-111 (captured, M3-T009) names 73-11/73-13/73-18 as the permit-required CF-use categories carved out of the residential-FAR cap; those three are MISSING from the folder (its 24-111 entry marks them cross-ref captured:false), so the OPEN reading question of whether 24-111 caps the R6B community-facility FAR (vs 24-11 at 2.00) rests on text the readers do not have. Option 8's 'split lot' meaning is owner question N1 (OPEN); the reference cases (benchmark-options-4-11.json ~1876, benchmark-options-5-8-9-10.json ~2194) record that the Article VII Chapter 7 district-boundary sections (77-00) were NOT among the pinned captures, so no district-boundary reading is possible from captured text. 23-154 (UAP) is named in prose only across options 2/11, is NOT a value basis and not load-bearing for this generating site, but an HTTP 403 has blocked it on every attempt; the index note recommends the browser-UA print/PDF-node fallback. A rule or reference case may cite a section only once captured with provenance (CLAUDE.md 2,3,12). DEFERRED, NOT in this batch (never silently omitted): the children of the three 73-xx parents (73-111/112, 73-131..136, 73-181..185) and the rest of Chapter 7 (77-02/03/23/29/30/31/32/321/322/33/331/332 — parking/tower/open-space, not reached by option 8's use+bulk reading); the shared-housing sections (option 9, City-of-Yes framework pending 2027) stay NOT CAPTURED.

risks: R1: 23-154 is likely to stay 403 (H12 re-confirmed HTTP 403 on the article page 2026-10-15). Treat it as a CONDITIONAL output; do NOT block the batch on it; keep the honest unknown and the existing index note.

R2 (M3-T013/DB-276 table-digest discipline): a table-bearing capture MUST carry table_digest_sha256 == sha256 of the canonical JSON of the PARSED payload (json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))); a non-table capture MUST NOT carry the key — snapshots.py fails closed either way and tests/rules/test_zr_snapshot_table_digest.py guards it. All owed sections verified prose this pass; the producer re-checks the page read this pass.

R3 (City of Yes 12/5/2024 renumbering): take every number/title/node/date from the page read this pass; the planner's 2026-10-15 cross-check (73-11/13/18 all 6/6/2024; Chapter 7 last amended 3/22/2016) is a cross-check, not a substitute; report, never invent, a missing/renumbered node.

R4: parent-heading sections (73-11/13/18 point to children; 77-10/77-20 are use/bulk headings) carry little body — capture the heading text as shown, list the children/neighbours as adjacent-not-in-batch (S8); do not synthesize a body.
